title: projects.yml
description: The set of repos this installation supervises, plus the optional Decision Inbox host. The governance_repo is the canonical doctrine + default Decision Inbox host. Supervised repos are the ones whose PRs the bot gates.

governance_repo.description: Owner/name of the governance repository. Holds canonical doctrine + receives Decision Inbox issues (unless decision_inbox.repository overrides).

supervised_repos.description: Owner/name of each repository whose PRs the bot gates (L1-L4). The governance_repo itself MAY be listed here if you want its PRs gated too.

bot_repo.description: Owner/name of the bot's own repository, if separate from governance_repo. The classifier votes Quadrant D on PRs to this repo. If absent, defaults to governance_repo.

decision_inbox.description: Optional. Override Decision Inbox host and lifecycle thresholds. If absent, defaults are: repository = governance_repo, thresholds = 14-day nudge / 30-day abandon / 60-day auto-close.

repository.description: Owner/name of the repository where Decision Inbox issues are opened. Defaults to governance_repo. Use when you want a separate inbox repo for many supervised repos to share.

thresholds.description: How long an inbox issue may remain in each state before escalation.

nudge_days.description: Days of no activity before the bot posts a reminder comment.

abandon_days.description: Days before the issue is labelled decision:abandoned (still open).

auto_close_days.description: Days before the bot closes the linked PR and the inbox issue.

break_glass.description: Optional. Tune the break-glass auditor's ADR deadline. Default: ADR required within 24 hours of any [break-glass-*] commit on main.

adr_deadline_hours.description: Hours after a break-glass commit during which an ADR referencing the commit SHA must land in docs/decisions/. Past this window the L5 auditor surfaces an 'unaudited' Issue.

audit_only_repos.description: Optional (DEC-C). Repos that are AUDITED on main (L2 post-merge re-validation + L5 break-glass + the unauthorized-push detector) but whose open PRs are NOT gated (L1-L4 skipped). Use for the governance repo so it can be supervised without the self-gating paradox. Each entry should also appear in supervised_repos. Default [] = every supervised repo is fully gated (v1.0.0 behavior).

repo_overrides.description: Optional (R1). Per-repo configuration overrides keyed by 'owner/name'. A key present here overrides the corresponding global default for that repo only.

required_checks.description: Named CI check-runs that MUST each be present + green on a PR head for C2 (and L2) to pass in THIS repo. Overrides the global env.yml required_checks. An explicit empty list [] forces 'no named checks' for this repo (back to the all-completed-checks-succeed behavior) even when a global default is set.
